content.application_contract: This revised candidate deliberately selects one bounded physical-handoff application of the former ambiguous exchange label. It does not claim that the old label uniquely established an item handoff, and it does not qualify gesture-only or information exchanges. Use one independently declared existing initiating hand, the complete nonempty independently declared existing other-hands scope, and one independently declared existing generic physical item. Select these exact targets from the frozen request/input/core before discovery. Each hand must have independently declared entity presence and the exact entity.type/v1 value hand. The item must have independent entity presence and the exact entity.kind/v1 value physical_item. The initiating hand must be explicitly disjoint from each other hand, and the item explicitly disjoint from every hand. These are application prerequisites, not new entities, a fixed anatomical count, a subtype inferred from a label or a category-to-owner default. Retain every independently declared ownership and part relationship. Neither human identity, a common carrier nor different people is required. Select macro shot scale and hands-only participant framing. Only the participating hands are visible as participant anatomy; the existing item remains visible, and this does not require deletion of unrelated background. Perform the physical handoff in progress on the selected item with every selected hand as an actual receiver. Keep that performed action as an effect rather than a frozen-action prerequisite, context or preservation. Both image framing effects require the separately selected complete framing_affected_owners inventory. That inventory must already be explicitly authored from all actual frozen request inputs before discovery, with exact existing presence for every member. It must name every actual owner affected by this macro coverage and crop, including the selected item and hands and each separately declared affected carrier, body region or other scene object. Its membership must be directly reviewed against the actual request, topology and selected framing. An inventory label, complete flag, hash or successful selector validation does not establish that semantic completeness. Do not invent a carrier, equate a hand with its carrier, infer descendants or construct this inventory from a discovered candidate. Both framing effects have the item, every selected hand and every member of that complete framing inventory as actual receivers. The independent framing scope may overlap the explicitly repeated hand/item endpoints; expand the exact union without inventing another entity or omitting an actual receiver. If any affected carrier or body region cannot be independently addressed and included, this application is not eligible. Apply all actual owner, ancestor, partial-property and whole-dimension locks to this complete union. No exact finger pose, contact configuration, support geometry, item coordinate, trajectory, completed ownership transfer, item subtype, camera hardware, focal length, focus plane or depth of field is selected here. If an actual selected application adds any such mutation, it requires its own complete source/effect/receiver review before use. Preserve independent identity and topology.

anatomical_connection.description: Ownership and continuity, articulation, attachment or explicitly intended separation of anatomical parts of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation; non-anatomical artifact joins remain separate.
anatomical_connection.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 해부학적 부위 소유·연속·관절·부착 또는 명시적으로 의도된 분리이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 꽃·잎·자기 줄기 연결도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 형태·비율·단순 접촉·비해부학적 공예물 접합과 구별하며 생존·성장·종을 추정하지 않는다.
evidence_terms: bloom attached to its own stem
excludes: Anatomical contour, regional volume, relative proportion or part names alone without an actual ownership, continuity, articulation, attachment or intended-separation proposition.
Touching, nearness, overlap or visual alignment of separately owned subjects/objects alone; contact does not merge anatomy or establish a shared biological owner.

Object hinges, hardware branches, textile/lace/paper flower assemblies and floral graphic-path joins alone. Depicted anatomical connection requires an explicitly declared anatomical depiction and remains scoped there, never inferred live continuity.

Continuity/attachment does not prove that an owner is alive, growing, functional, healthy, a particular species or made by a particular process; a cut or depicted botanical part does not gain a hidden whole plant.

An artifact or picture cannot alter/add a living actor or plant merely because its design resembles a biological part. Actor/plant/representation owner labels, source effects and optional members/profiles are not independent anatomical evidence.
includes: Ownership and continuity, articulation or explicitly intended separation of declared human or other animal anatomical parts, retaining each actual owner and endpoint.

The declared botanical bloom remaining attached to its own woody stem; separate blossoms attaching along the same continuous branch; leaves belonging to that same declared plant/branch. Source-stated absence or separation is retained without inventing extra organs.

Explicit anatomical attachment/continuity within a declared representation remains on the represented anatomy. A flat ornament path or assembled craft junction alone does not establish an anatomical relation.

Where a fabric rosette and a separate existing biological flower coexist, their distinct owners remain distinct: the flower own petal/stem relation cannot be donated to the garment, and cloth attachment cannot be recast as plant growth.

body_form.description: Owned non-facial anatomical contour, regional volume or visible muscle and tendon form of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation. Independent of connection topology, relative proportions, pose, garment fit and non-anatomical artifact construction.
body_form.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 얼굴 이외 해부학적 윤곽·국소 부피·근육·힘줄 형태이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 기관 형태도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 연결 구조·상대 비율·자세·의복 부피·비해부학적 물건 구조와 구별하며 생존 상태·종·건강·능력·정체성을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Body/plant region names, biological class words or connection topology alone without an independently stated anatomical contour or regional form.
Relative proportions, pose, facial geometry, garment fit or non-anatomical object/garment construction alone.

Floral graphic paths, repeating vegetal ornament, branch-shaped hardware or fabric/paper/lace flower parts do not become biological anatomy from resemblance or petal/stem labels. An explicitly declared anatomical depiction may describe represented organs only; its physical carrier remains an artifact.
A represented or artificial anatomical form does not alter or add a living actor/plant, and does not establish that its carrier is alive or that any depicted species exists physically.
Body weight, health, strength, biological age, origin, species, growth capacity, material chemistry or fabrication inferred from form.
Source owner, positive form and actual application scope must be explicit; metadata, source effects, an optional member/profile or an actor/plant/representation role word alone is not a form fact.
includes: Restrained visible muscle planes on a declared human or other animal; a localized neck vein contour or gluteal-thigh surface fold.

Large distinct floral segments forming an open cup on the declared botanical bloom; broad bounded leaf form or layered flower-organ form on its own declared plant owner. Plant form is not a claim of physiological life, growth capacity or species identification.

Explicitly depicted biological anatomy, including represented botanical organ form, stays on its declared representation. The source must actually describe anatomical form, not merely a floral style, motif or generic craft part.

A biological flower and a fabric rosette may occur in the same record, but anatomical form is assessed only on the declared biological flower or explicit anatomical depiction; cloth-fold form remains on the garment/craft owner.
